sources.ref: kestrel-site.html (saved copy of the Kestrel Labs homepage)

name.note: The name in the page metadata, the logo's title and the footer, without the legal form B.V.

colors.primary.note: Your cobalt: the logo mark, the buttons, the links and the key figures.

colors.foreground.note: The site's text colour, a deep navy ink rather than black.

colors.secondary.note: Your amber, used on the site for the release tag and for links on dark panels; documents use it for tags and callouts, never for text.

typography.body.note: The site's body text face, an open font from Google Fonts.

typography.heading.note: The site's heading face, also the face of the logo lettering; an open font from Google Fonts.

typography.headingWeight.note: Headings on the site are set at 700.

logo.value: inline SVG in the site header (kestrel mark and 'kestrel labs' wordmark)
logo.note: The header logo that links to the home page, used as it is on paper.

voice.register.value: Plain, concrete operations English: real times, real numbers, the reader's own trucks and crews.

voice.sample.value: At 07:40 truck 14 lost hydraulics on Maasboulevard. Kestrel spread its 63 remaining stops over trucks 9 and 22, and both drivers had the new route on their tablets by 07:42.

notes.name: We took the name from the page title data, the logo and the footer; documents say Kestrel Labs and leave the legal form B.V. to the footer of contracts.
notes.logo: The cobalt mark with the kestrel labs wordmark from your site header, used as it is; in dark mode the navy lettering turns into the light text color and the cobalt is lifted a shade, so both stay readable on the dark page.
notes.tone: Short sentences with the actual time, number or street in them: what happened, what Kestrel did, what the driver or the developer sees next.
